entries.title: The Workshop
text: Where the journey begins. Mara, the Workshop caretaker, keeps it in order.

entries.title: The brass plaque
text: THE PILLAR GALLERY. A hidden line glows beneath the old lettering:
A polished lens once focused the gallery's light.

entries.title: The Gallery light
text: Mara fitted the polished lens, and the Gallery light shines again.

entries.title: The archive ledger
text: The archive clerk in the Gallery east wing has the ledger back.

entries.title: The brass key
text: A small brass key stamped with a gate bolt. It opens the Gallery Storeroom door.
